t: You are looking at the French Protestant Church of London, on Soho Square. It serves the French-speaking community of London, a congregation that has been here since 1550, and it is the last remaining Huguenot church in the city. The current building is Grade II* listed. It was designed by Aston Webb and built between 1891 and 1893. Webb is the architect who designed the principal façade of Buckingham Palace and the main building of the Victoria and Albert Museum, so you are standing before the work of a very prominent hand.
